lastCompletedStory.title: Add required updatedAt field: schema + type + creation stamp + backfill

nextStoryContext: US-001 is done: updatedAt is now a required IssueEntry field, stamped equal to createdAt by every from-scratch creation writer (buildIssueEntry in src/issues/alloc.ts; issue-file.ts:306 flows createdAt through the same writeIssueFile -> buildIssueEntry path so no separate stamp was needed there), and backfilled onto all 296 existing scripts/cam/issues/CAM-*.json files via a new `bun scripts/cam/migrate-issues-schema.ts --backfill-dir [dir]` CLI mode (idempotent: re-run produces 0 updates). migrateEntry's idempotency guard was split: entries already carrying updatedAt pass through unchanged, entries otherwise-fully-migrated but missing updatedAt get backfilled (= createdAt), and the full-transform path sets updatedAt = raw.updatedAt ?? raw.createdAt (never now()). US-002 (stamp updatedAt on every MUTATION writer: specify/abandon/merge/close/demote/triage rank-change) is next and is a clean continuation -- it should override updatedAt to the injected clock() value on the mutated entry, NOT touch createdAt, and NOT re-touch the creation writers this story already covers. Gotcha for whoever touches more IssueEntry fixtures later: bulk-adding a field to test literals via perl needs -0777 slurp mode (line-by-line -pe corrupts embedded-newline replacements), and any blind sweep must exclude writeIssueFile({...}) call sites (those are WriteIssueFileOptions, not IssueEntry -- adding updatedAt there is a TS2353 error, not a fix). CAM issue schema is intentionally NOT byte-identical between scripts/cam/issues.schema.json and templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json (dogfood carries specSource/derivedFrom/allOf, templates doesn't) -- both were edited independently per patterns.md CAM-235.

officialDocsValidated.summary: No runtime JSON-schema validator (ajv or similar) parses issues.schema.json in this repo; the schema files are documentation-only artifacts, not lib-consumed. All other changes (IssueEntry type, alloc.ts, migrate-issues-schema.ts) are pure in-repo TypeScript with no external library surface.
